title: Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Chiffon Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine bright in this Sequin Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress! Featuring shimmering sequins, delicate chiffon, and romantic ruffle sleeves, this elegant gown is perfect for making a statement at any formal event or special occasion.


Tips: Can be stretched by at least 2 inches, though the waistband has limited elasticity.Prioritize selecting based on bust and waist measurements.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
